Cheer For a Cure is an annual cheer competition held in Tulsa, OK for competitors and teams in grades K - 9 that are sponsored by recreational youth programs or schools across Oklahoma. CFAC gives young people the opportunity to be involved in helping raise funds for the incredible Oklahoma Project Woman through a sport they are passionate about. Attending an event at Arvest Convention Center is an exciting experience. To fully enjoy your event experience, arrive early and consider the various transportation and parking options available.
